query:
INSERT INTO userProgress (id, userId, currentWeek, currentUnit, completedUnits, learningDuration, uiLanguage, startedAt, lastActivityAt)
SELECT 
  CONCAT('progress_', u.id),
  u.id,
  1,
  1,
  '[]',
  12,
  'en',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
FROM users u
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM userProgress p WHERE p.userId = u.id
);
